routing_records.name: cocosair
routing_records.description: Route Cocos AIR (cocosair.js) work to the right cocosair-* subsystem skill and enforce Code First discipline - original Scene, Node, Camera, Component, Material, Texture2D and Sprite APIs, WebGL2-only rendering, createAirApp bootstrap ordering, and the source-export / bundle-reachable / browser-verified capability layers. Use when starting any cocosair.js task, adapting Cocos Creator knowledge to AIR, hitting WEBGL2_REQUIRED or USE_TEXTURE failures, or deciding which AIR skill to load.

metadata.description_zh: 为 Cocos AIR 任务选择主技能和直接依赖，并遵循原生 API、启动时序与能力证据分层。用于开始 AIR 开发、定位能力归属或选择技能。

routing_records.name: cocosair-2d-subsystems
routing_records.description: Drives the Cocos AIR 2D subsystem runtime modules in code-first scenes - the sp namespace and loadWasmModuleSpine plus the BLOCKED Spine backend and asset sourcing state, dragonBones ArmatureDisplay, DragonBonesAsset, DragonBonesAtlasAsset, CCFactory and AnimationCacheMode with realtime versus cached skinning on the vendored dragonbones-js, TiledMap, TiledMapAsset, TiledLayer, TiledObjectGroup and TiledTile built from runtime tmx and tsx strings, ParticleSystem2D and ParticleAsset fed by a generated plist through assetManager.parser.parsePlist, MotionStreak (exported as MotionStreak, there is no MotionStreak2D), and Billboard as a scene.Model whose size and rotation travel through one cc_size_rotation uniform. Use when a Spine skeleton draws nothing without any error, when a TiledMap cell edit or object query does not refresh or resolve, when plist-tuned particles compute but render no pixels, or when a billboard is invisible at its default size.

metadata.description_zh: 配置 Spine、DragonBones、TiledMap、二维粒子和 Billboard 的原生运行时契约。用于资源构造、空白画面或子系统能力边界问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-agent-session
routing_records.description: Drives and inspects a running Cocos AIR app from an agent or devtool session. Covers the window.__airApp page binding, the devtools agent-session request protocol in tools/debug/agent-session.ts (requestId/action/targetId/params returning requestId ok result or error, the INVALID_ARGUMENT duplicate-requestId rejection, inspectScene and inspectNode snapshots, captureFrame on AFTER_DRAW, getRuntimeErrors ring buffer), the visual probe pixel-region conventions, and the runtime AirDiagnostics bounded channel. Use when an agent needs to observe a live scene, apply a controlled write, capture a frame, read runtime errors, or wire the dev-only session, remembering the session and probe surface are devtools not default-runtime APIs.

metadata.description_zh: 使用开发工具观察运行时、按明确范围写入、捕获画面和读取诊断。用于实时应用检查或受控自动化，工具不属于默认运行时包。

routing_records.name: cocosair-animation-tween
routing_records.description: Drives the Cocos AIR animation and tween surface - the code-first tween(target) chain (to/by/set/delay/call/sequence/parallel/repeat/repeatForever/reverseTime/union/clone/timeScale plus start/stop/pause/resume and the target-bound statics), TweenSystem and its ActionManager, the native Animation component (play/stop/pause/resume/getState/createState/addClip/crossFade, executionOrder 99, playOnLoad), AnimationState wrapMode whose setter resets time and repeatCount, code-first AnimationClip construction, the AnimationClip.WrapMode static enum, the animation namespace that is the only route to VectorTrack and TrackPath, createStepClock single-clock stepping with its dual-clock guard, and the unpublished marionette and pose-graph state. Use when a tween will not reverse, when a clip plays once instead of looping, when track classes fail to import by name, when deterministic frame stepping is needed for evidence, or when pose-graph animation is assumed available.

metadata.description_zh: 使用 AnimationClip、Animation 和 tween，管理播放模式、组合及单一时钟。用于动画播放、补间回收或确定性步进问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-application
routing_records.description: Configure createAirApp options, canvas, lifecycle, screen sizing and context health. Use for WEBGL2_REQUIRED startup errors, scene replacement, session cleanup or lost contexts.
when_to_use: createAirApp rejects options or fails startup
replace or release the running scene
app closed and will not restart
fit a container or set design resolution
lost context or scene cleanup stalls
not_for: package imports or page shell -> cocosair-project-setup

metadata.description_zh: 配置 createAirApp 和应用生命周期、屏幕尺寸、会话清理及 WebGL 上下文健康。用于启动错误、场景替换、关闭和自定义 canvas。

routing_records.name: cocosair-assets
routing_records.description: Drives the Cocos AIR asset surface - the Code First loading route (assetManager.assets registry plus loadAssetAsync and its gltf, resources, registry, then URL deserialize order), the reference-counted AssetBank over assetManager.loadRemote with the ext and cache-key rules, the subscriber-side-only signal and the full AIR_E_* throw map, the two-object texture model where ImageAsset carries CPU pixels and Texture2D samples them through reset, uploadData, updateMipmaps and the wrap and filter setters, parseAtlasText and createAtlasHandle for libGDX TexturePacker text atlases with top-left rect.y semantics, and parseFnt, createBitmapFont and loadBitmapFont for single-page BMFont. Use when assetManager.resources is null, when load or loadRemote is not an importable name, when reloading the same URL hands back a destroyed asset, when an atlas or font handle refuses to dispose, or when a label still renders with a system font.

metadata.description_zh: 管理远程资产、AssetBank 引用计数、纹理、图集和位图字体。用于加载、缓存、取消、共享资源释放或字体导入问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-audio-video
routing_records.description: Drives Cocos AIR audio, video and WebView from code - AudioService business channels over AudioSource (load, playBgm, pauseBgm, resumeBgm, stopBgm, setBgmVolume, playSfx, setMusicEnabled, setSfxEnabled, bgmState, dispose, maxSfxVoices cap with sfxDropped), measured-currentTime playback evidence, browser autoplay gesture unlock, VideoPlayer DOM-overlay events and transparent video, WebView iframe limits and evaluateJS. Use when audio starts silently or play() seems ignored, when proving a channel actually advances, when a video or iframe must sit under or over the WebGL canvas, or when WebView loads the wrong URL on mount.

metadata.description_zh: 管理音频通道、用户手势解锁、播放证据、VideoPlayer 和 WebView。用于媒体加载、播放、平台限制或资源清理。

routing_records.name: cocosair-camera
routing_records.description: Add and drive the Cocos AIR Camera component with the original Cocos APIs - projection switching between PERSPECTIVE and ORTHO, fov and fovAxis, orthoHeight and orthoWidth, near and far clip planes, the normalized rect viewport and priority draw order, visibility layer masks, the screen-to-world conversions worldToScreen/screenToWorld/screenPointToRay/convertToUINode in left-bottom-origin physical pixels, the AIR frameObject(camera,target,fallbackDistance=6) framing helper over MeshRenderer worldBounds, and the oblique near plane via calculateObliqueMat and clip-space minZ. Use when adding or configuring a camera, switching perspective or ortho, stacking a split-screen or overlay second camera, fitting a model in view, converting pointer pixels to a world ray or UI node, or debugging AIR_E_ORTHO_WIDTH and wrong screenToWorld results.

metadata.description_zh: 配置相机投影、视口、可见层和多相机顺序，并进行坐标转换、射线拾取与模型取景。用于相机配置或屏幕与世界坐标问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-gltf
routing_records.description: Load glTF/GLB models, extensions, decoder injection and instances. Use for Draco/meshopt/KTX2 deployment, GLTF_DECODER_MISSING, uncoded load errors or animation loops.
when_to_use: load a glTF or GLB from URL or bytes
destroying a model leaves GPU resources
not_for: skeleton bind poses or morph weights -> cocosair-skinning-morph

metadata.description_zh: 加载 glTF 和 GLB，配置解码器、扩展、进度、实例和错误处理。用于模型加载、压缩资源部署和加载器能力诊断。

routing_records.name: cocosair-graphics-and-dom
routing_records.description: Reuse native Cocos objects for 2D drawing and DOM in Cocos AIR. Covers AirGraphicsCommand drawing data replayed on a Graphics component (drawAirGraphics, solid nonzero only), SVG serialization that preserves curves (airGraphicsCommandsToSvg), Canvas2D rich fills into a native Texture2D (rasterizeAirGraphics), borrowed-texture display (createAirTextureSprite), per-Sprite channel masks (attachAirSpriteMask), opt-in UI blend inheritance including ParticleSystem2D (createAirUIBlendScope), DOM elements that follow UI nodes (createAirDOMOverlay), the AirUIMesh renderer, and the experimental HTML-in-canvas texture subpath (cocosair.js). Use when authoring or exporting vector fills, gradients, patterns, sprite masks, blend scopes, texture sprites, DOM overlays, or live HTML textures, rather than copying PixiJS or Creator editor snippets.

metadata.description_zh: 使用 Graphics、SVG、栅格填充、纹理显示、遮罩、混合和 DOM 覆盖层。用于绘图导出、富填充或实验性 HTML 纹理。

routing_records.name: cocosair-input-action
routing_records.description: Wires native input events and the AIR action layer in code-first Cocos AIR - the engine input singleton and systemEvent globals, EventTouch/EventKeyboard/EventMouse with the Input.EventType and SystemEvent.EventType enums and KeyCode key codes, createActionState as a pure held/pressed/released/axis reducer keyed per (action, source) with seven reset reasons and no listener removal, createActionInput over the native or dom backend where dom needs an explicit canvas and skips editable targets, createSessionGate for session admission, and SceneStack persistent-page navigation with dual-page transition, capture-phase input block and LRU eviction. Use when handling touch/keyboard/mouse in a Cocos AIR scene, when keys stop firing because an input or textarea has focus, when a dom action backend throws for a missing canvas, when a held button must survive a blur or page-hidden reset, or when push/pop page state must be preserved during a transition.

metadata.description_zh: 处理原生和 DOM 输入、动作状态、焦点、会话门禁及 SceneStack。用于按键触摸、动作映射、输入阻断或清理问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-materials-effects
routing_records.description: Configure materials, effects, uniforms, defines and GLSL. Use for setProperty, missing textures, AIR_E_MATERIAL_NOT_READY, AIR_E_MATERIAL_TYPE or uniform buffer too small.

metadata.description_zh: 配置材质、效果、属性类型、宏和自定义 GLSL。用于 USE_TEXTURE、uniform 类型、效果初始化或材质诊断问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-math
routing_records.description: Do vector, matrix, quaternion, rect, size and color arithmetic with the original Cocos math types in Cocos AIR - the math namespace and top-level exports, Vec2/Vec3/Vec4, Mat3/Mat4, Quat, Rect, Size and Color plus v2/v3/v4/quat/mat4/color factories, the out-first static convention (Vec3.add(out, a, b)), frozen constants like Vec3.UP via Object.freeze, Mat4 column-major m00..m15 layout and S->R->T composition with fromSRT/toSRT, Quat euler degrees versus radians, Mat3/Mat4 inverse and mirror handling, epsilon comparison with approx, scalar utilities clamp/clamp01/lerp/inverseLerp/repeat/pingPong, randomRange/pseudoRandom, floatToHalf encoding, bits helpers and easing curves. Use when normalizing or projecting a direction, composing or decomposing a node transform matrix, picking a quaternion or euler rotation, packing a Color or hex value, choosing an easing curve for a manual tween, hitting a TypeError from writing Vec3.UP, seeing -0 or NaN in a position, or getting an all-zero matrix from Mat4.invert.

metadata.description_zh: 使用 Cocos 数学类型进行向量、矩阵、四元数、颜色和插值计算。用于坐标变换、旋转、颜色处理、缓动或确定性随机。

routing_records.name: cocosair-performance
routing_records.description: Drives the Cocos AIR draw-call and frame-budget surface - the only three batching routes (shared mesh across N renderers, Mesh.merge and BatchingUtility.batchStaticModel for static subtrees, utils.MeshUtils.createDynamicMesh with Mesh.updateSubMesh for per-frame geometry), instancing through the single USE_INSTANCING material define with its 1024-per-group split, dynamic atlas defaults and silent-null acceptance rules, 2D auto-batch keys on director.root.batcher2D, the profiler singleton counters behind the pipeline.profiler gate, on-demand rendering as game.pause plus game.step behind Director.EVENT_AFTER_DRAW, pixelRatioCap and the DPR import-order contract, and the recorded limits of the 50k starfield evidence. Use when draw calls equal object count, batching hundreds of cubes or sprites, hitting AIR_E_MESH_CAPACITY or AIR_E_PIXEL_RATIO_IMPORT_ORDER, enabling dynamicAtlasManager, showing the stats overlay, checking whether the loop is really paused, or cutting resolution on a slow device.

metadata.description_zh: 选择静态合批、动态图集和实例化，并检查性能统计、剔除和按需渲染。用于大量对象、动画或绘制性能优化。

routing_records.name: cocosair-physics
routing_records.description: Applies to physics in code-first Cocos AIR apps - choosing the 3D backend with createAirApp({ physics: 'builtin' | 'cannon' }) (default builtin), selectPhysicsBackend and the official last-registration-before-init rule, the query-only boundary of the builtin discrete collision detector (no gravity integration, no MeshCollider in the world, trigger events and raycasts still real), PhysicsSystem/RigidBody/Collider wiring and the bidirectional group-and-mask filter, error 9642 for default-physics-material (fatal on cannon, benign on builtin) and AIR's built-in material registration, and the pure-JS 2D box2d backend with PhysicsSystem2D, RigidBody2D, Collider2D, BoxCollider2D and the raycast/testPoint/testAABB queries. Use when dynamic bodies do not fall or stack, when triggers fire silently, when deciding between builtin and cannon, when 9642 appears in the console, or when asking whether ammo, physx or box2d-wasm ship (they do not).

metadata.description_zh: 选择 builtin 或 cannon，并区分碰撞检测、运动积分和二维 Box2D 的能力。用于刚体、触发器、射线查询或物理后端问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-primitives-mesh
routing_records.description: Builds and attaches procedural geometry in a Cocos AIR Code First scene - the nine primitives.* shape generators and their parameter defaults, the createPrimitiveGeometry(descriptor) helper whose box, sphere, cylinder, cone whitelist, integer segment cap of 1024, predicted-vertex cap and arc range throw RangeError AIR_E_PRIMITIVE_DESCRIPTOR, turning the returned IGeometry into a Mesh with utils.createMesh, hand-authoring a Mesh struct from gfx.Attribute and Format rows and reading or copying vertex attributes and indices, and driving MeshRenderer hooks such as bakeSettings, setInstancedAttribute and morph setWeight. Use when generating a box, sphere, cylinder or cone without a Creator asset, wiring a BufferGeometry-style object to a renderer, hitting AIR_E_PRIMITIVE_DESCRIPTOR, choosing new Mesh plus struct versus primitives.box, reading mesh vertex attributes, or exporting geometry as OBJ or wireframe.

metadata.description_zh: 构建基本几何和原生 Mesh，检查顶点属性、索引、边界与渲染器写入契约。用于代码生成几何或自定义网格。

routing_records.name: cocosair-project-setup
routing_records.description: Set up npm imports, package entries, importmap, TypeScript and variant builds. Use for cocosair.js installation, unresolved-import errors, page shells or build artifacts.
when_to_use: imports resolve to the wrong entry
wire a page importmap and canvas
which build command produces this artifact
not_for: live HTML textures or overlays -> cocosair-graphics-and-dom

metadata.description_zh: 安装和配置 Cocos AIR 项目，选择包入口、importmap、TypeScript 声明和变体构建。用于安装导入、页面骨架、类型解析或构建产物问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-rendering
routing_records.description: Configure lighting, shadows, render targets, MSAA and sRGB. Use for offscreen pixels, post-processing, AIR_E_RENDER_TARGET_SAMPLES or AIR_E_TEXTURE_COLOR.
when_to_use: render mirror or refraction into a texture
texture looks washed out after load

metadata.description_zh: 配置灯光、阴影、渲染目标、MSAA、颜色契约和管线可达性。用于光照、阴影、离屏渲染、读回或后处理问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-scene-graph
routing_records.description: Build and drive the Cocos AIR scene graph with the original Cocos APIs - Scene as the Node tree root, Node addChild/insertChild/removeChild/removeFromParent/setParent and getChildByUuid, active versus activeInHierarchy hiding, local setScale versus inherited worldScale, the Component lifecycle order onLoad onEnable start update lateUpdate onDisable onDestroy, node on/off/once/emit events and exactly what node.destroy() does and does not unsubscribe, Layers bits with UI_2D and DEFAULT and addLayer plus makeMaskInclude/makeMaskExclude, find by path, NodePool put/get, scene.globals ambient fog skybox lightProbeInfo activation, and Scene or SceneAsset addRef decRef plus autoReleaseAssets refcounting. Use when building or re-parenting nodes, ordering component lifecycle, subscribing node or input events, assigning camera-culling layers, pooling nodes, or releasing scenes without leaking.

metadata.description_zh: 使用原生 Scene、Node、Component 构建场景树并管理层、事件、生命周期和资源释放。用于节点组织、组件更新、对象池或场景配置。

routing_records.name: cocosair-skinning-morph
routing_records.description: Drives Cocos AIR skeletal skinning and morph targets from code - SkinnedMeshRenderer skeleton and skinningRoot binding, Skeleton.joints as full paths relative to the skinning root with AIR_E_SKINNING_JOINT_PATH, buildSkeletonTree bindposes as inverse world matrices, restoreBindPose ancestor-first ordering, realtime versus baked pose through setUseBakedAnimation, joint palette capacity and AIR_E_SKINNING_CAPACITY, Mesh.morphRendering plus getBoneSpaceBounds, and MeshRenderer setWeight, setWeights and enableMorph. Use when a skinned mesh stays in rest pose or draws nothing, when a joint path throws AIR_E_SKINNING_JOINT_PATH, when moving bone nodes after setUseBakedAnimation(true) has no effect, when a morph weight setter appears to be ignored, or when binding a hand-built Mesh to a Skeleton without the Cocos Creator asset pipeline.

metadata.description_zh: 配置骨骼路径、蒙皮、绑定姿态、Morph 权重和烘焙动画。用于骨骼变形、绑定姿态恢复或 Morph 问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-ui-2d
routing_records.description: Drives code-first 2D UI in the Cocos AIR runtime - createUICanvas (Canvas plus fullscreen Widget plus an ortho UI camera bound through canvas.cameraComponent, defaults designWidth 1280, designHeight 720, layer Layers.Enum.UI_2D), the spriteNode and labelNode helpers and their real defaults (fontSize 28, lineHeight Math.round(fontSize*1.25), the AIR_E_LABEL_WRAP guard), the widget components Canvas, Widget, Layout (exported as Layout$1 as Layout), Button, ScrollView, ProgressBar, Slider, Toggle, EditBox, PageView, SafeArea and BlockInputEvents, each also aliased as ...Component, Label system-font and BMFont binding, LabelOutline, LabelShadow, LabelAtlas, the RichText-only-as-RichTextComponent alias, and 2D draw order through SortingLayers, Sorting2D and the Intersection2D utility. Use when a UI node renders nothing, when text needs a font without any Creator font-asset pipeline, when widgets must realign on a viewport change, or when 2D sprites and labels stack in the wrong order.

metadata.description_zh: 使用 Canvas、布局、控件、Label、位图字体和二维排序。用于 UI 构建、文本显示或交互布局问题。

routing_records.name: cocosair-verification
routing_records.description: Runs and interprets Cocos AIR verification gates without confusing subset or stale evidence with release readiness. Use when validating an AIR change, classifying a verify:* npm command as read-only or write, reading browser or package evidence, binding a report to its source and bundle fingerprints, telling UNSUPPORTED from FAIL, or preparing a release candidate that needs a clean worktree.

metadata.description_zh: 选择并解释 AIR 验证门禁、写行为、指纹和逐 API 证据。用于验证改动、包消费、浏览器行为或发布候选。
